## Made for this project (no third-party license)

| Asset | How it is made |
|---|---|
| Phobos and Deimos meshes | IrregularMoonMesh.cs: cratered, noise-displaced ellipsoids at real dimensions (Phobos 26.8 x 22.4 x 18.4 km with a Stickney-size crater; Deimos 15.0 x 12.2 x 10.4 km) |
| Boulders, rocks and ice crystals | RockMeshFactory.cs: flat-shaded, noise-displaced icospheres and hexagonal ice prisms, drawn with GPU instancing by RockScatter.cs |
| Craters, dunes and the colony pad | MarsTerrainGenerator.cs: heightmap craters (bowl, rim, ejecta), asymmetric dune field, slope-based texture painting |
| Black hole, accretion disk, gravitational lensing | BlackHoleLensing.shader: per-pixel Schwarzschild photon-path integration with Doppler and gravitational shifts. No images are used. |
| Solar panel array | AssetIntegrationBuilder.cs: Unity primitives (no free panel model in the packs) |
| Astronaut sun visor and life-support backpack | AstronautSuit.cs: primitives attached to the rig's head and torso bones |
| Planet spheres and Saturn's ring | MeshBuilders.cs: equirectangular UV sphere and a radial-UV ring |

## Not scripted (add by hand, then record here)

- **Unity Asset Store free packs**: Downloads need a signed-in Unity account and the Asset Store EULA, so they cannot be scripted. Add each one through Package Manager > My Assets, then add a manifest entry with method 'manual'.
- **Sketchfab models**: Downloads need a signed-in account, and the license differs per model. Only CC0 or CC BY models qualify; record each one here before importing.

## Rules we follow

- No paid, pirated or license-unclear assets. Unknown license means we don't use it.
- NASA material: credit NASA. Never use the NASA insignia ("meatball"), logotype or "worm", and never imply that NASA endorses the game.
- CC BY assets: the attribution text above must stay in the shipped credits.
- Raw third-party files are git-ignored and re-fetched with `python3 tools/fetch_assets.py`, so the public repository never redistributes an asset pack on its own. Their `.meta` files are committed, which keeps prefab references stable.
